prior_information: All earlier SPARC results and the three sharp-CCC wins are public. Freeze before fitting this predictor. The 35 are a retrospective transfer check. New non-overlapping galaxies are required for prospective confirmation.
training: Exactly the 130 IDs in ../freeze.json/train_common. No EFE or split diagnostic enters feature choice.
model: Upstream sharp ccc_forward and rho_from_v with s=0.5*N. log10(rho_t/[Msun kpc^-3])=clip(b0+b1*log10(Sigma/100),3,12). Sigma=1e9*(0.5*L36+1.33*MHI)/(2*pi*(1000*Reff)^2) in Msun/pc^2. Reff is stellar half-light radius in kpc; Sigma is a global photometric/HI proxy. No target velocities. Do not use Vflat from the test curve.
optimization: Minimize mean across galaxies of mean radial squared velocity residual / max(eVobs,1 km/s)^2. b0 in [3,12], b1 in [-3,3]. Start with a 19x13 uniform grid and refine the best three starts with bounded Powell. Include frozen constant as a candidate.
evaluation: Fixed 35, no tuning. Report all paired losses, wins, mean difference per galaxy against previous constant CCC and forward MOND. Percentile paired galaxy bootstrap 10000, seed 143. Primary internal success requires the upper 95% bootstrap limit of new minus constant CCC to lie below zero. Improvement over MOND is a separate criterion with the same rule. Tier 2b requires independent replication, comparable calibrated inputs and an independently predictable threshold.
BTFR: Additional same-catalog test on the original R142 140/35 IDs with Vflat>0. Compare slopes 3.5 and 4, using the same global photometric/HI mass proxy as above. Fit one intercept per fixed slope using mean training log residual. No test intercept. Score squared mass residual in dex, paired whole-galaxy bootstrap. This diagnostic is distinct from the published integrated-mass ODR and its p-family RAR.
diagnostics: Compare train vs test within each inverse procedure. Surface brightness, Reff, Rdisk, Rmax and Hubble type T; empirical LSB defined by bottom training quartile of SBeff. Compare direct delta chi2/N to SBeff, Sigma and independent Chae environmental field. Overlap with SPARC and field coverage reported for external data. Associations exploratory. No per-object environment fitted from target curves.
clusters: Independent cross-regime transfer of frozen sharp CCC constant and frozen MOND on spherical published baryonic and total acceleration or mass profiles. Use gas AND stars, same radii, independent observed total profile, no cluster-specific refit. The predictor using stellar Reff has no identical cluster observable by default. Record hydrostatic and covariance limitations.
